text:
The snapshot looks like late 2009, most likely October 2009. The unemployment rate is 9.7%, and headline CPI is -1.44% YoY, which fits mid-2009 deflation. The fed funds rate is 0.11%, and the 10-year yield is 3.31%.

Industrial production at -10.73% YoY fits roughly July to September 2009. Unemployment of 9.7% points to August 2009, when it was 9.6% (9.7% in the earlier vintage), though October reached 10.1%. Headline CPI bottomed at -2.1% in July 2009, so -1.44% suggests August (-1.5%), and core CPI at 1.46% also fits August. The 10-year yield was about 3.31% at the end of August, which matches. Equity returns over 12m of -6.6% fit August 2009, as does a VIX of 25.19. The 6-month equity gain of 31.6% from the March low fits as well.

The 3-month payroll average of -318k fits roughly the May to July period, which would put it at August.
